AXEActionEvent

An event an action emits about its own work (spec/EVENTS.md, "Action events"): a ledger line rather than a request metric. Unlike AXEEvent it names the actor, because attribution is its purpose, so it goes to onActionEvent sinks and never to the analytics onEvent sinks.

Properties

action
action: string;

The action whose handler emitted the event; for a continue or resume, the originating action.

actor
actor: string | null;

Who the work was done as, in the application's terms; null when the action has no actor.

details
details: Record<string, JsonValue>;

What the action chooses to record: ids, revisions, sequence numbers. Never a payload.

errorCode
errorCode: WireError | null;

event
event: string;

What happened, as a dotted name in the action's namespace: surface.act.

schemaVersion
schemaVersion: 1;

status
status: WireStatus;

Outcome of the work the event records.

tenant
tenant: string | null;

ts
ts: string;

Availability

type Availability = 
  | {
  available: true;
  handoff?: undefined;
  reason?: undefined;
  requires?: undefined;
}
  | {
  available: false;
  handoff?: HandoffSpec;
  reason: string;
  requires?: Accept[];
};

Whether an action can be done right now, and if not, why and what would change that.

HandoffSpec

type HandoffSpec = Omit<Handoff, "resumeToken" | "expiresAt" | "url"> & object;

A handoff declared on an unavailable action: the Handoff object without the token members. url is optional here: a step taken inside the application itself has no page to send the person to. Such a handoff is reported (in availability and in error.details.handoff) and never becomes needs_human, whose Handoff needs a url to resume from ([P-HAND-1]).

Type Declaration

url?
optional url?: string;
